provenance: Bootstrap, fitted 2026-10-16 on the research sample: Open-Meteo Previous Runs API (the previous day's run, D+1) of 10 models (ALADIN CZ, ICON-D2, ICON-EU, IFS, IFS 0.25, AROME Austria, HARMONIE, ARPEGE Europe, GFS, UKMO 10 km; plain mean of those with the variable) at 8 lowland ČHMÚ stations (Prostějov, Pardubice, Brno-Tuřany, Mošnov, Praha-Ruzyně, Temelín, Karlovy Vary, Polom; the summits Milešovka and Lysá hora left out), 2026-08-15 to 2026-10-14, against ČHMÚ daily SSV and Fmax and hourly N. Out of sample (expanding window, >= 21 days, 40 test days, all 10 stations): sunshine MAE 2.78 -> 1.58 h, gust MAE 1.85 -> 1.16 m/s, hourly daytime cloud MAE 14.5 -> 13.4 %. Used until the nightly fit (`mvd sun-cloud-gust`) has 21 days of the outlook's own forecasts paired with observations; the outlook's set of models differs from this sample.

gust_part.provenance: Fitted 2026-10-16 on the research sample of the other variables (Open-Meteo Previous Runs API, previous day's run, plain mean of the 10 models with gusts) at the 8 lowland stations: largest gust per part of day (Prague time) against the largest ČHMÚ 10-minute Fmax of the part (at least 30 of 36 values), 2026-08-15 to 2026-10-14. check: expanding window (fitted on the days up to two days before each test day), 39 test days 2026-09-06 to 2026-10-14.
